quarterly_data.signal: Asked whether High Bandwidth Flash (the moderator named SK hynix and SanDisk) could undercut High Bandwidth Compute on TCO, Durga Malladi gave his own view after in-depth talks with memory vendors: 'HBF is trying to solve a slightly different problem. It is not quite exactly the same problem.' HBF uses flash in addition to DRAM for something else, which 'is not the same thing as increasing the memory bandwidth to the point that the decode performance becomes really good', though 'it has its own use case' and more work remains. He sees HBF as a stack 'kind of independent of this', while the HBM vendors are opening 'a parallel track' because they cannot offer anything like HBC through HBM for the foreseeable future ('Maybe 5 years down the stream, it is going to be a different story').
